Three.js r155 browser files are generated here at Maven build time.

Source artifact:
  org.webjars.npm:three:0.155.0

Generated target paths:
  target/classes/static/vendor/three/build/three.module.min.js
  target/classes/static/vendor/three/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js
  target/classes/static/vendor/three/examples/jsm/controls/TransformControls.js

There is no runtime CDN and no custom Spring MVC WebJar mapping.
